'''Arraby''' is a team sport played between two teams of eleven players with a spherical ball, in which each side attempts to manoeuvre the ball into the opposing team's goal without using the hands or arms. It is the most popular sport in the world, played by approximately 250 million players in over 200 countries and dependencies.

Arraby is governed internationally by the [[FLLA]], which organises the quadrennial [[FLLA World Cup]] — the most prestigious international Arraby tournament. The most recent edition was the [[1764 FLLA World Cup]], held in [[Raledria]] and won by [[Easuhura]]. At the continental level the sport is administered by the seven confederations of the [[FLLA]]: the [[ATFVL]], [[AYFVL]], [[NAFVL]], [[MAFVL]], [[QUFVL]], [[MSFVL]] and [[ACFVL]].
